card.name: Limiting words like until, only, except
card.fires_on: Restricting or conditional little words such as until, only, except and not, placed after a verb phrase, mostly in handling and storage instructions. They set a limit on when or under what condition something applies.

modes.label: until in preparation steps
modes.description: The word until marks the point up to which a product is kept or held in a state.
modes.example: The product should be re-folded and the side tab latched<< until>> ready to activate.

modes.label: only/not/except limiters
modes.description: Words that restrict a condition, like only, not or except, after a clause.
modes.example: If symptoms<< only>> occur intermittently or at specific times of

modes.label: not after if
modes.description: The word not in an if-clause about unused or unadministered product.
modes.example: Discard unused AQNEURSA suspension if<< not>> administered within 30 minutes.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words meaning directly or near and away from words meaning non, outside or unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on small words that set a limit or condition, such as until, only, except and not, in instructions.
